title: Er CE: Dispenser UI ↔ main board communication

source.oemTestTitle: Communication Error UI to Main Board

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before resistance checks or harness service. R-600a is flammable — follow sealed-system precautions when applicable.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power cord before servicing this appliance.

steps.title: Er CE on display?
steps.body: Er CE indicates communication failure between dispenser UI and main control board. Check pin backouts and pinched wires on dispenser UI harness first.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Er CE indicates communication failure between dispenser UI and main control board. Check pin backouts and pinched wires on dispenser UI harness first.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: System Diagnostic Mode entered. Navigate to the sensor test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After service mode entry, proceed with OEM sensor readout and resistance checks.

steps.title: Inspect dispenser UI harness
steps.body: Verify external 4-button dispenser UI harness is fully seated at main board and dispenser. In service mode, note dispenser UI firmware version scroll (tests after hardware tests).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify external 4-button dispenser UI harness is fully seated at main board and dispenser. In service mode, note dispenser UI firmware version scroll (tests after hardware tests).

steps.title: Er CE cleared?
steps.body: After harness repair and power cycle, is Er CE cleared?
steps.sourceExcerpt: After harness repair and power cycle, is Er CE cleared?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace dispenser UI and/or main control board when harness verified.

steps.title: Replace PCB(s)
steps.oemOutcome: Replace external dispenser UI or main control board per OEM parts guidance.

steps.title: Communication OK
steps.oemOutcome: Er CE cleared after harness or board service.
